_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Inti Player {player_id}, qed tilgħab {num_rounds} rawnds tal-Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Għandek ${pool} li għandek taqsimu dan ir-rawnd bejnek u Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Għamel offerta: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Jekk aċċettat → Inti tirċievi $(pool - X), l-ieħor player jirċievi $X
  - Jekk irrifjutat → It-tnejn jirċievu $0
  - Eżempju: [Offer: $3]  jew  'Nħoss li dan hu ġust. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Iddisiema dwar l-offerta b' [Accept] jew [Reject]
  - Eżempju: 'Dan jidher ragonevoli. [Accept]'
            'Wisq ingjust. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ir-Round {round_number} qed jibda! ---
Plejer {proposer_id} huwa l-proponent, Plejer {responder_id} huwa r-responder.
round.offer: Round {round_number}: Plejer {proposer_id} qed jagħmel offerta ta' ${offer} lil Plejer {responder_id} (qed iżomm ${keep}).
round.accepted: Plejer {responder_id} aċċetta! Ir-Round {round_number} qed jikseb: Plejer {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Plejer {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Totals ġodda: Plejer 0: ${total_0}, Plejer 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Plejer {responder_id} rifjuta l-offerta! Ir-Round {round_number} qed jikseb: It-tnejn qed jiksbu $0. Totals qed jibqgħu: Plejer 0: ${total_0}, Plejer 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Il-proponent għandu jagħmel offerta bl-użu tal-format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: L-ammont tal-offerta għandu jkun numru sħiħ validu.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: L-ebda offerta attwali li tista' tirrispondi għaliha.

outcome.win: Plejer {winner} rebaħ bi ${winner_total} total kontra Plejer {loser} li kellu ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: It-tnejn li huma spiċċaw b'total ta '$ {total}.
